BodyPolicy.description: Which bodies a channel keeps in the ledger. Every crossing is recorded either way, with its size and a sha256 of the body. The policy only decides whether the body itself is kept: a channel pushing a million product updates a day can keep just the failures, whose bodies are the ones anybody opens.
